5 (beş) iş günü önce
ehliyet fotokopisini teslim etmelidir

HGS sorunları SU Yetkilisine bildirilmelidir
driving under the influence of alcohol is not allowed
smoking in the vehicle is not allowed
no changes that change the quality of the vehicle and impair its standard equipment
TTS and HGS systems not assigned to non-university vehicles
Vehicle Allocation Notification Form
fine paid by SU and charged on payroll of responsible personnel
In case of damage to the vehicle, it should be reported to the SU specialist immediately
No damage can be repaired by the personnel assigned the vehicle without the knowledge and control of the SU specialist
In the event of an accident, a damage report is prepared at the scene and delivered to the SU specialist

In one-sided accidents, the traffic police report must be completed by the relevant personnel to whom the vehicle has been allocated, and the 'Damage Declaration Form' must be filled and delivered to the SU specialist

In accidents involving more than one party, a report must be prepared together with the other party, and copies of the other party's driving license, vehicle license and motor insurance must be taken and delivered to the SU specialist
The rental company can provide a replacement vehicle within 24 (twenty-four) hours from the moment the problem of the vehicle is determined and the need for a replacement vehicle is determined

ÖK Direktörü, oryantasyon programı bittikten sonra oryantasyon etkinliklerinin değerlendirilmesi amacıyla Oryantasyon Komitesi'ni toplantıya çağırır
